about: Frozen given names. A pin outranks the draw, so a name here can never move again — not when the syllable bands change, not when a species is added, not when the roster reorders. Joe, 2 Aug 2026, after the unseeded draw handed a six-year-old a rabbit called Defuck: "no dont change the generator, we hard fix the first 24 animals instead". These are that hard fix, approved by him on 4 Aug 2026. Every value is the name the allocator already produced, so pinning them renamed nothing: checked over all 320 species, zero moved.
